name: token-sync-inspector
title: Code-to-Figma Token Parity Inspector
author: Patrick Schrödter (ptrckschrdtr) <https://ptrckschrdtr.de>
description: Interactive semantic token inspector with Base UI Popover details and 1-click CSS variable copy.
